name: Monasticism and the religious life
description: The ideals and institutions of the monastic and canonical life: the rule, obedience, stability, communal prayer and worship, reform, and the tension between the cloister and the world. In Old English literature the theme centres on the Benedictine Reform and its literature of observance.

name: Medicine, healing, and the body
description: The care of the body in sickness and health: remedies, herbs, surgery, charms, and the learned and folk traditions of healing, together with the symbolic meanings of bodily suffering. Prominent in the Old English medical texts and in the hagiographic literature of miraculous healing.
